Definition: from G3499; decease; figuratively, impotency:--deadness, dying.
BiblicalUsage: Paul bears about in his body the dying of the Lord Jesus, and Abraham considers his own body as good as dead when the promise is given.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that dying is the way life shows: Paul carries the dying of Jesus in his body so that the life of Jesus may be seen, and Abraham's dead body is where the promise of life begins.
